h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhopal

items.pText: Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh, is often called the city of lakes, and its public gardens and lakeside walks are busy with families every evening. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Bhopal's parks, schools, housing societies, government colonies and hotels. We manufacture it at our factory in Vasai, about 640 km away, and deliver by road for installation by our team or a dealer in Madhya Pradesh.

A public garden on a lake front is a different job from a society garden. Footfall is high, and the play area is often one part of a larger plan with walking paths, lawns and seating. Bhopal's summers are hot, and the monsoon from June to September brings heavy rain. We plan a play area that drains well, sits clear of the paths and leaves space for parents to watch from benches nearby.

items.q: Can you design a play area for a large public garden?
items.a: Yes. Share the garden plan or photos and the space set aside for play. We suggest a feature structure with smaller pieces around it, and mark safe play areas and paths on a layout drawing.

items.q: How should a playground near a lake be planned?
items.a: Keep it well back from the water and fence that side. Place benches where parents can watch, and use a raised, drained base with rubber flooring under the equipment.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Bhopal?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, about 640 km away, and send the equipment to Bhopal by road. Our team or a dealer installs it.
